comparison_rule: Compared each saved gold status/value with its cited first-party source as available on 2026-11-24. Supported means the source directly supports the saved label; conflict means current source content directly contradicts it; partial means the source supports only part of the claim or does not settle the full prototype/production or taxonomy distinction. A current-source conflict can reflect source drift since the frozen excerpt was captured.
